notes.title: !!!! Release !!!!
notes.content:
[h1]Hello everyone. [/h1]
It's was a long way stretching for almost 4 years, involves cool moments, ups and downs. Watch to how the project changes from concept to release is always interesting, and in this post I will explain my way.

[h1]1. Learning the basics, "Hello World" another words [/h1]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/23858187/cd7c4719a45716c77465dfd6e3cc8960a4656d2e.jpg[/img]

[h1]2. UI and first experiments[/h1]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/23858187/21b1d891ea03fa3bd7fc40e6c51d8d9c7d50d369.jpg[/img] 

[h1]3. First playable build, GreenLight and first fail[/h1]
[i] Piece of.... creativity :) [/i]

https://youtu.be/L3OoanOqfSo
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6zJ5aVv1HiM

[h1]4. One more attempt [/h1]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/23858187/a931784055744b23a80075e2e431af789dd90fb2.jpg[/img]

[img]http://i.imgur.com/IXd3WFl.jpg[/img]
[img]http://i.imgur.com/m1OfZY0.png[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/23858187/7c8f9ec6c1f0b6aed546d4b7845bed6c9f6d8808.jpg[/img]

[h1]5.Steam. Early access [/h1]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/23858187/3c82b7fd53f8508b66e8ef0e565a855d3e22addd.jpg[/img][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/23858187/49966ed44187b59498e4a31c2d3b2223765d3396.jpg[/img][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/23858187/377ab32a0a037f91ec0b0357fb73f54f13f97831.jpg[/img]

Am grateful to everyone for your help in the passed way and the words that give me strength to go on.
I hope that this is just the beginning... @yo_serjio (Sergey Yurkin)
